changed: gain clamped to [0.6, 1.3], template blurred to the camera's blur; marker read by a small dark-blob search around the predicted tab instead of a fixed grid; marker centre now fixes the translation before LK

changed: head tab raised 138 px above the pivot (never overlaps the body tab); only the head is solved for rotation (the other pieces are slid, their angle comes from the fiducial); hands grip beside the tabs and come in from directions that do not cross the markers

saw: lying dog's muzzle touched the person's offered hand, so the look-in read as a look at the hand
changed: person sits further in (stage x 40), the low hand reaches to the floor short of the dog; look-in head card turned to 58 degrees (back of the head toward us, muzzle into the room)
